reason: The cited evidence shows Mo improves corrosion resistance and strength in DED HEAs (E1, E2), but only up to 10% Mo, not 25%. E3 mentions a 25% Mo variant showed potential in preliminary tests, but does not confirm film densification, microstructural refinement, or the synergistic wear-corrosion mechanism. Key premises about film nature, microstructural changes, and synergy are unsupported or only loosely related to the cited passages.
premises: Mo addition to DED-processed HEA forms a denser, Mo-rich passivating film
Mo addition refines microstructure (intermetallics, grain boundaries)
Mo-rich film and refined microstructure together enhance wear and corrosion resistance
25% Mo substitution is optimal for combined wear-corrosion resistance
Combined degradation is less than sum of individual wear and corrosion effects
